at 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix sel-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: sel-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card board create 'Second board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/second-board.txt

exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 create 'Default parent'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/default-parent.txt
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 create 'Default child'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/default-child.txt
exec card edit sel-2 --parent sel-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edited.txt
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 create 'Second issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/second-issue.txt
exec card board use board_11111111111111111111
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/use-second.txt

# Explicit issue IDs infer their board instead of requiring ambient selection.
exec card --json show sel-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/default-parent.json
exec card --json list --under sel-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/default-descendants.jsonl
exec card edit sel-2 --priority 1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edited.txt

# Explicit flag and environment selections are validated against inferred IDs.
env CARDAMOM_BOARD=board_11111111111111111111
! exec card show sel-1
! stdout .
stderr 'belongs to board "board_00000000000000000000"'
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 show sel-1
stdout 'Default parent'
! stderr .
env CARDAMOM_BOARD=

# Release validates an explicit board and otherwise follows the claimed issue.
exec card --actor alice claim sel-1
stdout 'Claimed sel-1'
! exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 --actor alice release sel-1
! stdout .
stderr 'belongs to board "board_00000000000000000000"'
exec card --actor alice release sel-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/released.txt

# One invocation cannot target issue IDs owned by different boards.
! exec card close sel-1 sel-3
stderr 'issue IDs belong to multiple boards'
exec card close sel-1 sel-2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/closed.txt
